lessons.objective: Learner can understand, explain and apply close reading and inference.
teaching_sequence: Start with a short original example.
Ask the learner to notice meaning or language clues.
Model evidence-based interpretation.
Guide one response and gradually remove support.
Require an original response in a new context.
lessons.checkpoint: Explain close reading and inference independently and complete a new example.

interactive_activities.title: Explore close reading and inference
interactive_activities.instructions: Complete an age-appropriate task focused specifically on close reading and inference. Record the evidence/work and explain what it shows.

interactive_activities.title: Apply the idea
interactive_activities.instructions: Create a new situation where vocabulary and language in context is useful. Explain your reasoning and compare it with a second example.

interactive_activities.title: Teach it back
interactive_activities.instructions: Teach evidence-based expression to a beginner in 3–5 clear steps, using an example or demonstration.

mastery_policy.on_failure: Route to weakest prerequisite/concept, reteach, practise and reassess.
